## Citations by year from the workbook's Citations sheet, one entry per
## source that has data
citeSources <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(c("Google Scholar", "Scopus"), getCitations))
## Google Scholar only, for citecounts.graph below
cites <- getCitations("Google Scholar")$byYear

citeHistory <- function(ct) {
  ct <- ct[order(ct$year), c("year", "cites")]
  ct2 <- ct
  ct2$cites <- cumsum(ct2$cites)
  ct$Type <- "Yearly"
  ct2$Type <- "Cumulative"
  ct <- rbind(ct, ct2)
  ct$Type <- factor(ct$Type, levels = c("Yearly", "Cumulative"))
  ct
}

citeplot <- if (length(citeSources) == 0) {
  ggplot() + ggtitle("Citation data unavailable.")
} else {
  ct <- rbindlist(lapply(citeSources, function(x) {
    cbind(citeHistory(x$byYear), Source = x$source)
  }))
  asOf <- unique(na.omit(format(do.call(c, lapply(citeSources, `[[`, "asOf")), "%B %Y")))
  ggplot(ct, aes(year, cites, fill = Source)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
    scale_y_continuous("Number of Citations", expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .05))) +
    scale_x_continuous("", breaks = seq(from = min(ct$year), to = max(ct$year), by = 2)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Google Scholar" = "#2c3e50", "Scopus" = "#18bc9c")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom") + 
    facet_wrap(~ Type, scales = "free_y") + 
    ggtitle(paste0("Citations by Year",
                   if (length(asOf)) sprintf(" (as of %s)", paste(asOf, collapse = "; "))))
}

## Link Project names to projects.html, matching the Projects sheet
## case-insensitively (e.g. "SleepCaRe" -> "SleepCare"). Names with no row
## there (HCHS/SOL, POSSUM) still get a link; Joshua chose to leave those as is.
projectNames <- read_excel(cvpath, sheet = "Projects")$Name
projectLinks <- function(x) {
  x2 <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ";")))
  canon <- projectNames[match(tolower(x2), tolower(projectNames))]
  x2 <- fifelse(is.na(canon), x2, canon)
  sprintf(" Project(s): %s.", paste(sprintf("[%s](projects.html#%s)", x2, projectAnchor(x2)), collapse = " and "))
}

printPubs <- function(year, d) {
  paste(c(
    sprintf("`%s`", as.character(year)),
    "<ol>",
    paste(sprintf("<li value = %d>%s%s</li>",
                  d[Year == year, Num], d[Year == year, Reference],
                  fifelse(!is.na(d[Year == year, Project]), 
        unlist(lapply(d[Year == year, Project], projectLinks)),
        "")),
          collapse = "\n"),
    "</ol>"), collapse = "\n")
}

## e.g. "**11** primary doctoral, **4** co-supervised doctoral, and **10** honours
## students", leaving out zero counts
studentCounts <- function(n) {
  n <- n[n > 0]
  x <- sprintf("**%d** %s", n, names(n))
  x <- if (length(x) > 2) {
    paste0(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), ", and ", x[length(x)])
  } else {
    paste(x, collapse = " and ")
  }
  paste(x, "students")
}

## SOFTWARE section: each package in the Software sheet, current ones first,
## with CRAN downloads and its latest March percentile rank from SoftwareStats
## when the package is on CRAN (counts are from Posit's mirror, so a floor)
softwareStats <- tryCatch(as.data.table(read_excel(cvpath, sheet = "SoftwareStats")),
                          error = function(e) NULL)

packageStats <- function(name) {
  if (is.null(softwareStats)) return("")
  d <- softwareStats[Package == name & Metric == "Downloads" & !is.na(Value)]
  r <- softwareStats[Package == name & Metric == "MarchPercentileRank" & !is.na(Value)][order(-Year)]
  parts <- character(0)
  if (nrow(d) > 0) {
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf("&gt;%s CRAN downloads (%s to %s)",
      fmtNum(belowRound(sum(d$Value), 1000)),
      format(min(as.Date(d$From)), "%Y"), format(max(as.Date(d$To)), "%B %Y")))
  }
  if (nrow(r) > 0) {
    ## pool size from the note, e.g. "vs ~25,729 CRAN packages" -> "~25,700"
    pool <- regmatches(r$Notes[1], regexpr("[0-9,]+(?= CRAN packages)", r$Notes[1], perl = TRUE))
    pool <- if (length(pool) == 1 && !is.na(pool)) {
      sprintf("~%s ", fmtNum(100 * floor(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", pool)) / 100)))
    } else ""
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf("March %d: on average more daily downloads than %.1f%% of %sCRAN packages%s",
      r$Year[1], r$Value[1], pool, if (isTRUE(r$Partial[1] == 1)) " (partial month)" else ""))
  }
  if (length(parts) == 0) "" else
    sprintf('\\\n[%s.]{.small .text-muted}', paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}
